questions.text: The radius of a right circular cylinder is increased by 20% and its height is decreased by 25%. What is the percentage change in the volume of the cylinder?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Volume V ∝ r²h. Treat r² as a single entity. % change in r² = 20 + 20 + (20×20)/100 = 44% increase. Net % change in V = 44 + (-25) + (44×-25)/100 = 19 - 11 = 8% increase. Full: Let original radius = r, height = h. Original Volume = πr²h. New radius = 1.2r, New height = 0.75h. New Volume = π(1.2r)²(0.75h) = πr²h × 1.44 × 0.75 = 1.08 πr²h. Percentage change = (1.08 - 1) × 100 = 8% increase.

questions.text: NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL) was incorporated in 2020 to internationalize UPI and RuPay. Which country became the first to adopt UPI QR code-based payments through NIPL in 2021?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Bhutan was the first country for RuPay card acceptance (2019) and logically the first for UPI QR (2021) due to deep financial integration and currency peg with India. Full Solution: NIPL launched UPI QR-based payments in Bhutan on July 13, 2021, in collaboration with the Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan (Bhutan QR). Nepal adopted UPI later (February 2022 via Gateway Payments Service), UAE (2023), and Singapore (2023 via PayNow-UPI linkage).

questions.text: According to the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Mutual Evaluation Report of India adopted in June 2024, India was placed in which follow-up category, indicating the highest level of compliance?
questions.solution: Shortcut: FATF has three main follow-up tiers: Regular (best/compliant), Enhanced (deficiencies), and Enhanced Expedited (serious deficiencies). India's near-perfect technical compliance score secured the top tier 'Regular Follow-up'. Full Solution: The FATF Plenary in Singapore (June 26-28, 2024) adopted India's Mutual Evaluation Report. India was rated 'Compliant' or 'Largely Compliant' on all 40 FATF Recommendations. Consequently, India was placed in the 'Regular Follow-up' category, the highest compliance tier, requiring only biennial reporting rather than intensive monitoring.

questions.text: Under the RBI's 'Framework for Acceptance of Green Deposits' (effective June 1, 2023), which of the following entities is explicitly excluded from the applicability of the framework?
questions.solution: Shortcut: RRBs and Local Area Banks (LABs) are typically excluded from new complex regulatory frameworks (like LCR, NSFR, Green Deposits) initially due to operational capacity constraints. Full Solution: The circular DBR.No.BP.BC.83/21.04.048/2022-23 dated April 11, 2023, applies to all Scheduled Commercial Banks (including Small Finance Banks) and all Deposit-taking NBFCs (including Housing Finance Companies). Para 3 of the framework explicitly states that Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Local Area Banks (LABs) are excluded.

questions.text: Statements: Some A are B. All B are C. No C is D. Conclusions: I. Some A are not D. II. All A are C. Which of the following is correct?

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution: Shortcut: Draw a mental Venn diagram – Some A are B, All B are C gives Some A are C; No C is D means that part of A which is C cannot be D, so Some A are not D. All A are C cannot be deduced. Full: The overlap of A and C is non‑empty and disjoint from D, hence conclusion I follows; conclusion II would require A ⊆ C, which is not given.

questions.text: As per the RBI's Basel III Capital Regulations, the Capital Conservation Buffer (CCB) requirement for scheduled commercial banks reached the fully phased-in level of 2.5% of Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) on which date?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The CCB phase-in was delayed twice due to COVID-19; the original 2019 deadline was extended to Sept 2020, then April 2021, and finally implemented from Oct 1, 2021. Full Solution: RBI originally mandated the full 2.5% CCB by March 31, 2019. Via circulars dated March 27, 2020 and February 5, 2021, the timeline was deferred first to September 30, 2020, then to April 1, 2021. A final circular dated May 5, 2021 deferred it further to October 1, 2021, making it the effective date for the fully phased-in buffer.

questions.text: In a queue of candidates, Raman stands 15th from the front and Shyam stands 20th from the back. If there are exactly 5 candidates standing between Raman and Shyam, what is the minimum possible number of candidates in the queue?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For minimum total with ranks from opposite ends and given 'between', assume overlap (they cross each other). Formula: Min Total = (Rank_front + Rank_back) - (Between + 2). Calc: (15 + 20) - (5 + 2) = 35 - 7 = 28. Step-by-step: 1) Let total = N. Shyam's position from front = N - 20 + 1 = N - 19. 2) Gap of 5 means position difference = 6. 3) Case 1 (No overlap, Raman before Shyam): (N - 19) - 15 = 6 ⇒ N = 40. 4) Case 2 (Overlap, Shyam before Raman): 15 - (N - 19) = 6 ⇒ 34 - N = 6 ⇒ N = 28. 5) Minimum valid N is 28 (Verify: N=28, Shyam at 9th from front, Raman at 15th, 5 persons between 10-14).

questions.text: Read the sentence to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any, will be in one part of the sentence. Mark the part with the error as your answer. (Ignore errors of punctuation, if any.) Neither the Finance Minister nor the senior officials (A) / was available for comment (B) / regarding the sudden fluctuation (C) / in the foreign exchange reserves. (D)

options.label: A
options.text: Neither the Finance Minister nor the senior officials

questions.solution: Shortcut: In 'Neither...Nor' constructions, the verb agrees with the noun/pronoun nearest to it (Proximity Rule). Here, 'senior officials' is plural, so the verb must be plural ('were'), not singular ('was'). Step-by-step: Identify the compound subject joined by 'Nor'. The subject closer to the verb is 'senior officials' (Plural). The verb 'was' (Singular) violates Subject-Verb Agreement. The correct verb is 'were available'. Parts A, C, and D are grammatically sound.

questions.text: As per the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC) Act, 1961, as amended effective February 4, 2020, what is the maximum insurance cover payable to a depositor per bank?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Link the hike to Budget 2020 announcement; eliminate ₹1 Lakh (pre-2020 limit) and ₹10 Lakh (proposed but not enacted). Step-by-step: The DICGC Amendment Act, 2020 raised the insurance cover from ₹1 lakh (static since 1993) to ₹5 lakh per depositor per bank, effective February 4, 2020, covering all commercial and cooperative banks.

questions.text: Select the option that best improves the underlined part of the given sentence. If the sentence is correct as it is, select the original option. 'Having submitted the application late, the rejection letter was received by the applicant.'

options.label: A
options.text: Having submitted the application late, the rejection letter was received by the applicant.

options.label: B
options.text: Submitting the application late, the rejection letter was received by the applicant.

options.label: C
options.text: Having submitted the application late, the applicant received the rejection letter.

options.label: D
options.text: The application having been submitted late, the rejection letter was received by the applicant.

questions.solution: Shortcut: A participial phrase at the start of a sentence ('Having submitted...') must logically modify the subject of the main clause. The 'rejection letter' cannot submit an application; only the 'applicant' can. Scan options for a main clause starting with 'The applicant'. Step-by-step: The introductory phrase implies the doer is the applicant. Options A, B, and D retain 'the rejection letter' as the subject, creating a dangling modifier. Option C correctly places 'the applicant' as the subject performing the action of submitting and receiving.

questions.text: The Account Aggregator (AA) framework, launched by the RBI in September 2021, operates under which specific category of Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) license?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The license category abbreviation directly matches the framework name (Account Aggregator -> NBFC-AA). Full Solution: The RBI introduced a distinct category of NBFC called 'NBFC-Account Aggregator (NBFC-AA)' via Master Direction in September 2016. These entities act as consent managers facilitating financial data sharing. NBFC-P2P is for Peer-to-Peer lending, NBFC-IFC for Infrastructure Finance Companies, and NBFC-MFI for Micro Finance Institutions.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of the expression (17^43 + 23^57)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Unit digit of powers follows cycles of 4. 17^43 → 7^43, 43 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit 3. 23^57 → 3^57, 57 mod 4 = 1 → unit digit 3. Sum of unit digits = 3+3 = 6.

questions.text: In a certain code language, consonants are replaced by the next letter in the alphabet and vowels are replaced by the previous letter (with wrap‑around). If "BANK" is coded as "CZOL", how will "RBI" be coded?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply the rule letter‑by‑letter: R (consonant) → S, B (consonant) → C, I (vowel) → H → "SCH". Full: For each letter in RBI, check vowel/consonant status; consonants shift forward one, vowels shift backward one (A→Z, E→D, I→H, O→N, U→T). Combining gives SCH.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "He is the only son of my mother's only daughter." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.solution: Shortcut: "My mother's only daughter" refers to the speaker herself (assuming no sisters). The only son of that daughter is therefore the woman's son. Full: The phrase identifies the speaker as the only daughter; the only son of that daughter is the speaker's son, so the man is her son.

questions.text: If 'P @ Q' means 'P is the mother of Q', 'P # Q' means 'P is the father of Q', 'P $ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q', and 'P % Q' means 'P is the sister of Q', then in the expression 'K @ L # M $ N % O', how is K related to O?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the Generation Gap method. Assign values: Parent (@, #) = +1; Sibling ($, %) = 0. Calculate cumulative gap from K to O: K@L (+1), L#M (+1), M$N (0), N%O (0). Total gap = +2. Determine gender of K: '@' implies Mother (Female). A female with +2 gap is Grandmother. Full Solution: K is mother of L. L is father of M. M is brother of N, so M and N are siblings. N is sister of O, so N and O are siblings. Thus M, N, O are siblings with father L. K is mother of L, making K the grandmother of O.
